Hello James,

I hope you are having a great week. My name is Marcos Gonzalez and I am the Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal, where we help federal contractors keep evolving regulations from slowing down operations. I have been following TSS-JCC's Indian Health Service hospital project in Oregon, and with the bulk of the work still ahead, I wanted to check in to see how performance is going. Standing up an ANC-sponsored joint venture right after JCC's 8(a) graduation is a real accomplishment, and it also creates a distinctive compliance profile since joint-venture work-share and limitations-on-subcontracting rules, certified payroll under Davis-Bacon, and mandatory-disclosure obligations all tend to draw closer government scrutiny as a build like this ramps up. Having experienced government contracts counsel on call can keep those requirements from ever slowing the project down.

I would love to connect briefly to introduce myself and see how we might support Taurus as it continues to grow. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and my law clerk, who would also participate in any scheduled call.

Warmly,
Marcos Gonzalez
Managing Attorney
